title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-120-26二模

items.zh: 毋庸置疑,那些古老的遗迹总是令人心驰神往。
items.en: There’s no doubt that those ancient remains are always captivating.

items.zh: 要想养活这些娇嫩的花儿,就得保证光照充足、浇水及时、营养充分。
items.en: To help these delicate flowers survive, they must be given enough sunlight, timely watering and sufficient nutrients.

items.zh: 这位年轻的天文学家从未料到,儿时观星的爱好,竟会逐渐变成自己的职业追求。
items.en: It never occurred to the young astronomer that his childhood hobby of stargazing would evolve into his career pursuit.

items.zh: 这座重建后的博物馆,其设计初衷是让参观者放慢脚步,而非走马观花。它邀请人们以自己的方式去探索、思考、畅想未来。
items.en: Originally designed to slow visitors down rather than rush through exhibits, the rebuilt museum invites them to explore, think and imagine the future in their own way.
